verses.ar: قَصِيدَةٌ لِأَيْثَانَ ٱلْأَزْرَاحِيِّ بِمَرَاحِمِ ٱلرَّبِّ أُغَنِّي إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. لِدَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ أُخْبِرُ عَنْ حَقِّكَ بِفَمِي.
verses.kjv: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.web: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي قُلْتُ: «إِنَّ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ تُبْنَى. ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ تُثْبِتُ فِيهَا حَقَّكَ».
verses.kjv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.web: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

verses.ar: «قَطَعْتُ عَهْدًا مَعَ مُخْتَارِي، حَلَفْتُ لِدَاوُدَ عَبْدِي:
verses.kjv: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
verses.web: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

verses.ar: إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ أُثَبِّتُ نَسْلَكَ، وَأَبْنِي إِلَى دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ كُرْسِيَّكَ». سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.web: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ تَحْمَدُ عَجَائِبَكَ يَارَبُّ، وَحَقَّكَ أَيْضًا فِي جَمَاعَةِ ٱلْقِدِّيسِينَ.
verses.kjv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.web: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ مَنْ فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ يُعَادِلُ ٱلرَّبَّ. مَنْ يُشْبِهُ ٱلرَّبَّ بَيْنَ أَبْنَاءِ ٱللهِ؟
verses.kjv: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? [who] among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
verses.web: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,

verses.ar: إِلَهٌ مَهُوبٌ جِدًّا فِي مُؤَامَرَةِ ٱلْقِدِّيسِينَ، وَمَخُوفٌ عِنْدَ جَمِيعِ ٱلَّذِينَ حَوْلَهُ.
verses.kjv: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all [them that are] about him.
verses.web: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ إِلَهَ ٱلْجُنُودِ، مَنْ مِثْلُكَ؟ قَوِيٌّ، رَبٌّ، وَحَقُّكَ مِنْ حَوْلِكَ.
verses.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, who [is] a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
verses.web: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ مُتَسَلِّطٌ عَلَى كِبْرِيَاءِ ٱلْبَحْرِ. عِنْدَ ٱرْتِفَاعِ لُجَجِهِ أَنْتَ تُسَكِّنُهَا.
verses.kjv: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.web: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ سَحَقْتَ رَهَبَ مِثْلَ ٱلْقَتِيلِ. بِذِرَاعِ قُوَّتِكَ بَدَّدْتَ أَعْدَاءَكَ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
verses.web: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

verses.ar: لَكَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ. لَكَ أَيْضًا ٱلْأَرْضُ. ٱلْمَسْكُونَةُ وَمِلْؤُهَا أَنْتَ أَسَّسْتَهُمَا.
verses.kjv: The heavens [are] thine, the earth also [is] thine: [as for] the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.web: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

verses.ar: ٱلشِّمَالُ وَٱلْجَنُوبُ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَهُمَا. تَابُورُ وَحَرْمُونُ بِٱسْمِكَ يَهْتِفَانِ.
verses.kjv: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
verses.web: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

verses.ar: لَكَ ذِرَاعُ ٱلْقُدْرَةِ. قَوِيَّةٌ يَدُكَ. مُرْتَفِعَةٌ يَمِينُكَ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, [and] high is thy right hand.
verses.web: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

verses.ar: ٱلْعَدْلُ وَٱلْحَقُّ قَاعِدَةُ كُرْسِيِّكَ. ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَٱلْأَمَانَةُ تَتَقَدَّمَانِ أَمَامَ وَجْهِكَ.
verses.kjv: Justice and judgment [are] the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
verses.web: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلشَّعْبِ ٱلْعَارِفِينَ ٱلْهُتَافَ. يَارَبُّ، بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ يَسْلُكُونَ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [is] the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.web: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.

verses.ar: بِٱسْمِكَ يَبْتَهِجُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ، وَبِعَدْلِكَ يَرْتَفِعُونَ.
verses.kjv: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.web: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ فَخْرُ قُوَّتِهِمْ، وَبِرِضَاكَ يَنْتَصِبُ قَرْنُنَا.
verses.kjv: For thou [art] the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.web: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ مِجَنُّنَا، وَقُدُّوسَ إِسْرَائِيلَ مَلِكُنَا.
verses.kjv: For the LORD [is] our defence; and the Holy One of Israel [is] our king.
verses.web: For our shield belongs to Yahweh, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ كَلَّمْتَ بِرُؤْيَا تَقِيَّكَ وَقُلْتَ: «جَعَلْتُ عَوْنًا عَلَى قَوِيٍّ. رَفَعْتُ مُخْتَارًا مِنْ بَيْنِ ٱلشَّعْبِ.
verses.kjv: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon [one that is] mighty; I have exalted [one] chosen out of the people.
verses.web: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

verses.ar: وَجَدْتُ دَاوُدَ عَبْدِي. بِدُهْنِ قُدْسِي مَسَحْتُهُ.
verses.kjv: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.web: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي تَثْبُتُ يَدِي مَعَهُ. أَيْضًا ذِرَاعِي تُشَدِّدُهُ.
verses.kjv: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.web: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

verses.ar: لَا يُرْغِمُهُ عَدُوٌّ، وَٱبْنُ ٱلْإِثْمِ لَا يُذَلِّلُهُ.
verses.kjv: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.web: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

verses.ar: وَأَسْحَقُ أَعْدَاءَهُ أَمَامَ وَجْهِهِ، وَأَضْرِبُ مُبْغِضِيهِ.
verses.kjv: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.web: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَمَانَتِي وَرَحْمَتِي فَمَعَهُ، وَبِٱسْمِي يَنْتَصِبُ قَرْنُهُ.
verses.kjv: But my faithfulness and my mercy [shall be] with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.web: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

verses.ar: وَأَجْعَلُ عَلَى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَدَهُ، وَعَلَى ٱلْأَنْهَارِ يَمِينَهُ.
verses.kjv: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.web: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

verses.ar: هُوَ يَدْعُونِي: أَبِي أَنْتَ، إِلَهِي وَصَخْرَةُ خَلَاصِي.
verses.kjv: He shall cry unto me, Thou [art] my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.web: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

verses.ar: أَنَا أَيْضًا أَجْعَلُهُ بِكْرًا، أَعْلَى مِنْ مُلُوكِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Also I will make him [my] firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.web: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

verses.ar: إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ أَحْفَظُ لَهُ رَحْمَتِي. وَعَهْدِي يُثَبَّتُ لَهُ.
verses.kjv: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.web: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

verses.ar: وَأَجْعَلُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ نَسْلَهُ مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ.
verses.kjv: His seed also will I make [to endure] for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.web: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.ar: إِنْ تَرَكَ بَنُوهُ شَرِيعَتِي وَلَمْ يَسْلُكُوا بِأَحْكَامِي،
verses.kjv: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.web: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

verses.ar: إِنْ نَقَضُوا فَرَائِضِي وَلَمْ يَحْفَظُوا وَصَايَايَ،
verses.kjv: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.web: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

verses.ar: أَفْتَقِدُ بِعَصًا مَعْصِيَتَهُمْ، وَبِضَرَبَاتٍ إِثْمَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.web: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

verses.ar: أَمَّا رَحْمَتِي فَلَا أَنْزِعُهَا عَنْهُ، وَلَا أَكْذِبُ مِنْ جِهَةِ أَمَانَتِي.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.web: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

verses.ar: لَا أَنْقُضُ عَهْدِي، وَلَا أُغَيِّرُ مَا خَرَجَ مِنْ شَفَتَيَّ.
verses.kjv: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.web: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

verses.ar: مَرَّةً حَلَفْتُ بِقُدْسِي، أَنِّي لَا أَكْذِبُ لِدَاوُدَ:
verses.kjv: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
verses.web: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

verses.ar: نَسْلُهُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ يَكُونُ، وَكُرْسِيُّهُ كَٱلشَّمْسِ أَمَامِي.
verses.kjv: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.web: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

verses.ar: مِثْلَ ٱلْقَمَرِ يُثَبَّتُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. وَٱلشَّاهِدُ فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ أَمِينٌ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and [as] a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.web: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

verses.ar: لَكِنَّكَ رَفَضْتَ وَرَذَلْتَ، غَضِبْتَ عَلَى مَسِيحِكَ.
verses.kjv: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.web: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

verses.ar: نَقَضْتَ عَهْدَ عَبْدِكَ، نَجَّسْتَ تَاجَهُ فِي ٱلتُّرَابِ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown [by casting it] to the ground.
verses.web: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

verses.ar: هَدَمْتَ كُلَّ جُدْرَانِهِ جَعَلْتَ حُصُونَهُ خَرَابًا.
verses.kjv: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.web: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

verses.ar: أَفْسَدَهُ كُلُّ عَابِرِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ صَارَ عَارًا عِنْدَ جِيرَانِهِ.
verses.kjv: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.web: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

verses.ar: رَفَعْتَ يَمِينَ مُضَايِقِيهِ، فَرَّحْتَ جَمِيعَ أَعْدَائِهِ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.web: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا رَدَدْتَ حَدَّ سَيْفِهِ، وَلَمْ تَنْصُرْهُ فِي ٱلْقِتَالِ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.web: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

verses.ar: أَبْطَلْتَ بَهَاءَهُ، وَأَلْقَيْتَ كُرْسِيَّهُ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.web: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

verses.ar: قَصَّرْتَ أَيَّامَ شَبَابِهِ غَطَّيْتَهُ بِٱلْخِزْيِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.web: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

verses.ar: حَتَّى مَتَى يَارَبُّ تَخْتَبِئُ كُلَّ ٱلِٱخْتِبَاءِ؟ حَتَّى مَتَى يَتَّقِدُ كَٱلنَّارِ غَضَبُكَ؟
verses.kjv: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.web: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

verses.ar: ٱذْكُرْ كَيْفَ أَنَا زَائِلٌ، إِلَى أَيِّ بَاطِلٍ خَلَقْتَ جَمِيعَ بَنِي آدَمَ!
verses.kjv: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
verses.web: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

verses.ar: أَيُّ إِنْسَانٍ يَحْيَا وَلَا يَرَى ٱلْمَوْتَ؟ أَيٌّ يُنَجِّي نَفْسَهُ مِنْ يَدِ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ؟ سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: What man [is he that] liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.web: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

verses.ar: أَيْنَ مَرَاحِمُكَ ٱلْأُوَلُ يَارَبُّ، ٱلَّتِي حَلَفْتَ بِهَا لِدَاوُدَ بِأَمَانَتِكَ؟
verses.kjv: Lord, where [are] thy former lovingkindnesses, [which] thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
verses.web: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

verses.ar: ٱذْكُرْ يَارَبُّ عَارَ عَبِيدِكَ ٱلَّذِي أَحْتَمِلُهُ فِي حِضْنِي مِنْ كَثْرَةِ ٱلْأُمَمِ كُلِّهَا،
verses.kjv: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; [how] I do bear in my bosom [the reproach of] all the mighty people;
verses.web: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي بِهِ عَيَّرَ أَعْدَاؤُكَ يَارَبُّ، ٱلَّذِينَ عَيَّرُوا آثَارَ مَسِيحِكَ.
verses.kjv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.web: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

verses.ar: مُبَارَكٌ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ. آمِينَ فَآمِينَ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [be] the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.web: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
